question: Who among the following is credited with popularising the catchphrase ‘Inquilab Zindabad’?
solution: The correct answer is __**Bhagat Singh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • Slogan - Inquilab Zindabad. • Inquilab Zindabad refers to the "Long live revolution". • This slogan was first given by Moulana Hasrat Mohani. But later it was popularized by Bhagat Singh after he and B. K. Dutt had thrown a bomb on the central legislative assembly in Delhi in 1929. • Bhagat Singh wrote an essay titled Why I am an Atheist in 1930 in Lahore Central Jail. • After the death of Singh, the essay was published on 27 September 1931 in Lala Lajpat Rai's English weekly 'The People'.
